shortDescription: Refresh all vcenters configured in networker.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Networker rest api url. You also can set the environment variable NETWORKER_HOSTNAME as hostname.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the Networker username for api access. You also can set the environment variable NETWORKER_PASSWORD as password.

options.name: username
options.description: Networker username for api access. You also can set the environment variable NETWORKER_USER as username.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Enable or disable certificate check for api access.

options.name: wait_for
options.description: Seconds to wait for vcenter refresh before proceed.
